def on_change_completed_part(self, newtext):
    """Change the part we're currently completing in the commandline.

    Args:
        text: The text to set (string).
    """
    text = self.text()
    cursor_position = self.cursorPosition()  # Get the current cursor position
    if text[0] in STARTCHARS:
        prefix = text[0]
        text = text[1:]
    else:
        prefix = ''
    parts = split_cmdline(text)
    logger.debug("Old text: '{}' - parts: {}, changing to '{}'".format(
        text, parts, newtext))
    parts[-1] = newtext
    self.setText(prefix + ' '.join(parts))
    self.setFocus()
    self.show_cmd.emit()
